notes.endGroups: lose is ONLY for a player who is actually out (negative cash flow, no cash, loan limit reached; its lines say the cash ran out). A multiplayer player who did not win but is still in the game gets end.neutral (its lines never mention cash). win lines are true for any win; the optional win.fastPayback / win.diversified / win.noBankLoan lines may be appended as a second line only when their condition holds (spec section 2.4).

loanTotalLabel.label: סך הכול להחזיר
loanTotalLabel.combined: סך הכול להחזיר {total}, אם תפרעו בסיכום הקרוב
loanTotalLabel.usage: For the loan window row next to {total}: show the qualifier as a small caption under or beside the number. It is not a total until the loan ends (no end date; interest continues).

notes.round11: Every group that can appear in family mode now has a 'family' list that uses kid vocabulary only (see 'forbiddenInFamily' in docs/v2/tutorial/spec.md). Groups that had only 'all' now carry 'all' (adult/both) plus 'family'. In family mode the slots {interest}/{monthlyPayment} read as 'תוספת'. Full-only groups (buy.stock, expense.forcedSale, market.sold/kept/priceUp/priceDown) are unchanged.
notes.resolve: Pick lines[group][mode]; if missing use lines[group].all; if still missing use the family list. Choose one line at random but never the same line twice in a row for a group.

slots.title: card title
slots.years: payback phrase WITH unit, from the UI plural helper: 'שנה אחת', 'שנתיים', '4.2 שנים'
slots.yield: annual yield with percent sign, e.g. '24%'
slots.monthly: asset monthly cash flow, formatted with currency
slots.loss: absolute value of a negative monthly cash flow, formatted with currency
slots.loanAmount: principal of THIS loan (a multiple of LOAN_STEP), formatted. For expense.loan it can be larger than {amount}, which is the expense
slots.rate: LOAN_APR_NOMINAL with percent sign, e.g. '12%': the NOMINAL yearly rate (monthly rate x 12), not the effective rate. Derived from config, never typed. Not used in family lists
slots.monthlyPayment: loanTerms(loanAmount).monthly: what this loan adds to the monthly payments (interest only, loanAmount x LOAN_PAYMENT_RATE), formatted
slots.interest: loanTerms(loanAmount).perPayday = monthlyPayment x PAYDAY_MONTHS: the interest charged at each summary (24 months) while the loan stays open, formatted. Same number as the loan window row 'ריבית עד הסיכום הבא'
slots.total: loanTerms(loanAmount).totalAtPayday = loanAmount + interest, formatted. It is the sum to hand back ONLY if the loan is repaid at the next summary (principal stays owed until repaid, interest continues every month). Texts must always say 'אם תפרעו/מחזירים בסיכום הקרוב' next to it. It is NOT a total until the loan ends (there is no end date). Same number as the loan window row 'סך הכול להחזיר'
slots.saved: monthly payment that disappears after a repayment (loanMonthlyPayment of the repaid amount), formatted
slots.shares: number of shares with the symbol, already plural-aware (e.g. one share of MAV / 10 shares of MAV)
slots.symbol: stock name as shown on the card
slots.over: offer above the purchase price, as percent, e.g. '25%'
